description: Branch R-FMT-1 II-04 calculated types (public side) on an ACCDB. For each result type (Yes/No, Byte, Integer, Long, Currency, Single, Double, Date, Text(255), Memo, Decimal) its own table CT<type>(ID Long, A Long, C calculated) is made through CreateTableDef, with Field.Expression put before the field is appended; each step's DBEngine.Errors follows a marker. Rows A = 5, Null and 0 are inserted and read back; C's Type, Size, Attributes and property list (Expression, ResultType where present) are read. Asks which result types ACE admits as calculated columns, what each reads back, and what the field reports.
